query: I'm choosing a city for a 3-month remote-work stay: Lisbon or Mexico City. Research two completely separate angles: (1) the digital nomad visa requirements and process for each city's country, and (2) typical one-bedroom apartment rental cost in a central neighborhood of each city. Cite a real source URL for every claim.

criteria.answer: Covers digital nomad visa requirements for BOTH Portugal and Mexico with real source URLs
Covers one-bedroom rental costs in BOTH Lisbon and Mexico City with real source URLs — this facet must not be dropped in favor of only the visa facet
Every claim cites a real, fetched source URL, not a fabricated or unattributed one

query: Research two unrelated topics for a newsletter: (1) the current world record for the men's 100m sprint and who holds it, and (2) the main cause of the 2010 Eyjafjallajökull volcanic eruption's air-travel disruption in Europe. query: Research niche B2B technology opportunities in Colombia for 2026 where a small software team could realistically generate revenue. Focus only on niches where (a) a recent Colombian or EU regulation forces a specific customer segment to adopt technology, and (b) that segment has demonstrated real capacity to pay, and (c) local competition is weak or nonexistent. Exclude fintech, last-mile delivery and routing apps, construction ERP software, and generic legaltech — those markets are saturated. Identify 4 to 6 niches. For EACH niche state: the exact regulation creating the obligation (name/number and compliance deadline), who the paying customer is and evidence of their capacity to pay, at least one existing local or international competitor, and a market-size or export figure. Many of the best sources are in Spanish — search in Spanish as well as English. Every claim must cite the real source URL you fetched.

criteria.answer: Identifies 4 to 6 distinct B2B niches in Colombia, each tied to a named, real regulation (Colombian resolution/decree/law or EU regulation) with a concrete number or date
Does NOT recommend fintech, last-mile delivery/routing, construction ERP, or generic legaltech as a niche — the query explicitly excluded them
Each niche names at least one real, existing competitor or provider (local or international)
Every market-size, export, or customer-count figure is attributed to a cited source URL, with no unattributed statistics
